name: Coastal Road Scenes in Xiamen: Beauty and Uniqueness
description: Method replication: same task, scales and design as the paper; the images are not the paper's stimuli (38 new places along the Island Ring Road in Xiamen, each as four Baidu street views at 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°, captured 2019–2021). Original study: Zhang, Xiong, Yang, Zhang, Chi, Wen, Zhang & Wang (2025), PLOS ONE 20(1): e0317585, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0317585. The authors took Baidu street views in four directions at 1,340 points along Xiamen's urban coastal roads, chose 38 points with a factorial design over the share of sky, plants, buildings, sea and coastal features (palms, islands, beaches, landmarks, bridges), and asked 1,649 people online (Wenjuanxing) to rate each point for aesthetic and distinctiveness perception on a 7-point scale, with the image order randomised. Differences from the original study: (1) the 38 points were picked by hand from 60 sampled points on the Island Ring Road to cover open sea views, lawns, palms and built-up stretches, not by the paper's factorial design; (2) each place is shown as a 2×2 grid of its four views and rated on "How beautiful is this place?" and "How unique is this place?" (1 very poor, 7 excellent), wording taken from the same group's Suzhou study because the paper does not print its question text.
